shared_elements: low-relief carving of living forms on a vertical face
repeated figures arranged in a vertical/horizontal sequence
justification: A shows schematic quadrupeds (an animal in profile above what appears to be another creature) carved in shallow relief on a narrow pillar face, while B shows a procession of elaborately costumed human figures with crowns, staffs, and handled vessels arranged in a horizontal frieze over a rosette border. The only correspondence is the generic one of profile figures in low relief stacked or lined up in sequence; the subject matter (animals versus courtly humans with attributes) and the degree of naturalistic detail are entirely different.
